Principal companies are Thermos K.K. and Zenmashi (China) Household Products Co., Ltd. entries.8aef146514edc4e0: In Japan, this business manufactures and sells industrial gases such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, helium and hydrogen, specialty gases including electronic material gases, LP gas and medical gases, and manufactures and constructs gas-related and electronics-related equipment. Cutting equipment and laser processing machines, liquefied carbon dioxide and dry ice, and sales and rentals of medical equipment are also included here. The main companies are Taiyo Nippon Sanso Corporation (renamed Nippon Sanso Corporation effective April 1, 2026), NISSAN TANAKA Corporation, Nippon Ekitan Corporation, Nippon Megacare Corporation and I.M.I. Corporation, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥406,296 million (down 0.9% year on year), the largest of the five reportable segments. In industrial gases, price management had an effect on carbon dioxide, packaged gases and electronic material gases, but revenue decreased as shipment volumes of separate gases and LP gas fell. In equipment and construction, revenue increased in electronics-related business due to progress in construction for medium- and large-scale projects, while revenue in industrial gas-related business decreased.

entries.d9d831b2b3389f57: In Europe, this business manufactures and sells oxygen, nitrogen and argon, provides home healthcare services, and sells medical equipment. The main companies are Nippon Gases Euro-Holding S.L.U. (renamed Nippon Sanso Euro-Holding S.L.U. effective April 1, 2026), Nippon Sanso Homecare España, S.L.U., Nippon Gases Belgium NV, Nippon Gases Industrial S.r.l., among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥350,978 million (up 6.8% year on year), the third largest business. Gas shipment volumes declined, but revenue increased due to the effect of exchange rates and price management. In equipment and construction, revenue increased due to solid performance in medical-related equipment and construction, and the addition of revenue from an Italian plant engineering company acquired in the previous fiscal year.
entries.dcfa9ca42a68ca9c: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,359,611 million, up 3.9% year on year. Revenue from external customers was ¥406,296 million for Japan (down 0.9% year on year), ¥360,557 million for the United States (up 0.1%), ¥350,978 million for Europe (up 6.8%), ¥208,452 million for Asia and Oceania (up 18.1%) and ¥33,263 million for Thermos (up 2.1%). Group-wide shipment volumes of products and merchandise decreased from the previous year, but the group worked on pricing management to pass cost increases on to selling prices and on productivity improvement programs in each region. Because of the effect of foreign exchange rates, revenue is shown as approximately ¥22.9 billion higher overall.
entries.e0fea8889db4087e: This business manufactures and sells industrial gases such as oxygen, nitrogen and argon, and specialty gases, and sells welding-related equipment and gas-related equipment, in Southeast Asia, China, Taiwan, South Korea, Australia and other regions. Principal companies include Nippon Sanso Holdings Singapore Pte. Ltd., Leeden National Oxygen Ltd. (renamed Nippon Sanso Singapore Ltd. effective April 1, 2026), Coregas Pty Ltd and Taiwan Nippon Sanso Co., Ltd., among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥208,452 million (up 18.1% year on year), making it the fourth-largest business. In industrial gases, revenue rose as the LP gas sales business in Australia, acquired in the previous fiscal year, and the industrial gas business in Oceania, acquired in the current fiscal year, were added. In electronics-related business too, revenue increased because shipment volumes of electronic materials gases were recovering and equipment and construction was solid.
entries.ea324a31c1cbdf00: In March 2026, the company formulated a new medium-term management plan, 'Next Innovation 2030 - Evolving for the Future', covering the fiscal year ending March 2027 to the fiscal year ending March 2030. Its key strategies are 3: strengthening the profitability of the industrial gas business, expanding the electronics business, and creating future growth drivers. For industrial gases, it cites accelerating the sharing of best practices through the expansion of Operational Excellence and expanding resilient businesses; for electronics, accelerating global deployment of Total Gas Supply Solutions, focused investment in advanced materials, and entry into new regions; and it states that it will proceed under a Center of Excellence (CoE) structure across the group. By segment, it cites expanding innovation businesses (stable isotopes and additive manufacturing) in Japan, expanding the healthcare business in Europe, and pursuing opportunities in HYCO business in Asia and Oceania, and states that Thermos aims to evolve from the vacuum flask business into a 'lifestyle brand'.
entries.f04e4dc65df95e39: It manufactures and sells industrial gases such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon and hydrogen, specialty gases including electronic material gases, carbon dioxide and dry ice, LP gas, and medical gases.
